description: Source code for QuicChaosProtector class implementing packet manipulation and obfuscation in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QuicChaosProtector
classes.description: Class responsible for creating obfuscated QUIC data packets with padding, frame reordering, and crypto data manipulation.

methods.name: QuicChaosProtector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the chaos protector with crypto frame, padding, packet size, framer, and random generator.

methods.name: BuildDataPacket
methods.description: Builds a data packet with crypto data, padding, and frames, returning packet size or nullopt on failure.

methods.name: WriteStreamData
methods.description: Method stub that should not be called; logs bug if invoked.

methods.name: WriteCryptoData
methods.description: Writes crypto data to the provided writer, with validation.

methods.name: CopyCryptoDataToLocalBuffer
methods.description: Serializes crypto frame data into a local buffer for manipulation.

methods.name: SplitCryptoFrame
methods.description: Splits crypto frames into smaller frames with random sizes, adjusting padding accordingly.

methods.name: AddPingFrames
methods.description: Adds ping frames as padding, up to a maximum count.

methods.name: ReorderFrames
methods.description: Randomly reorders frames to obfuscate frame order.

methods.name: SpreadPadding
methods.description: Distributes remaining padding as padding frames within the frame list.

methods.name: BuildPacket
methods.description: Constructs the final packet using the framer, temporarily setting this object as data producer.
